title: pkg/util: allow uid and gid options on tmpfs mounts
body:
<!-- Validation Checklist:

-->

### Problem

When creating containers via the Docker-compatible API or specifying mount options with explicit ownership on tmpfs mounts (such as `--tmpfs /mnt:rw,size=64m,mode=0700,uid=1000,gid=1000`), Podman rejected the options with:

```
container create: unknown mount option "uid=1000": invalid mount option
```

Docker and standard Linux tmpfs mount syntax support explicit numeric ownership options `uid` and `gid`.

### Solution

- Updated `processOptionsInternal` in `pkg/util/mount_opts.go` to recognize `uid` and `gid` mount options when `isTmpfs` is true.
- Enforced that duplicate `uid` or `gid` specifications are rejected with `ErrDupeMntOption`.
- Enforced that `uid` and `gid` options are disallowed on non-tmpfs mounts with `ErrBadMntOption`.
- Added unit tests in `pkg/util/utils_test.go` covering valid `uid`/`gid` options, duplicate options, and non-tmpfs rejections.

Fixes: #29979
Signed-off-by: sundeep8967 <sundeep8967@gmail.com>

comments.body: Please add an E2E or system test verifying the options are actually passed to the mount and ownership is correctly changed.

Added E2E and system tests in commit 39a09bf742 per maintainer review:

- Added E2E test in `test/e2e/run_volume_test.go` verifying `podman run --rm --tmpfs /mytmpfs:uid=1000,gid=1000 ...` correctly passes the options and sets ownership to 1000:1000.
- Added system test in `test/system/060-mount.bats` verifying `--mount type=tmpfs,destination=/mnt/tmpfs,uid=1000,gid=1000` correctly applies ownership.

Thanks @mheon for pointing that out. The test was incorrectly using `--mount type=tmpfs,destination=...,uid=1000,gid=1000` which uses mount option parsing where `uid`/`gid` are not options for `--mount`.

Updated the system test in `test/system/160-volumes.bats` to invoke `podman run --rm --tmpfs /mytmpfs:uid=1000,gid=1000 $IMAGE stat -c "%u:%g" /mytmpfs` matching the feature scope. Pushed updated commit `c5f8309966`.
Updated the e2e test in `test/e2e/run_volume_test.go` to use `podmanTest.PodmanExitCleanly(...)` as requested. Thank you @Honny1!
please use your real name for the commits and Signed-off-by line, we can merge once this is fixed
Updated the commit authors and Signed-off-by lines with my real name (`k j sundeep kumar <sundeep8967@gmail.com>`). Thank you @giuseppe!

Feels like this ought to be supported for `--mount type=tmpfs` as well, but I suppose that can wait for a follow-up PR.

LGTM
